info.title: Procest Case Management Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Procest case management application. Defines case types, status types, role types, result types, decision types, document types, property definitions, voorstel, parafeerroute, parafeeractie, and their instance counterparts.

caseType.title: Case Type
caseType.description: Case type definition — defines the blueprint for a category of cases including lifecycle, deadlines, and classification

description.description: Detailed description of this case type

purpose.description: The purpose or goal of this case type

trigger.description: What triggers the creation of a case of this type

subject.description: The subject matter of this case type

processingDeadline.description: ISO 8601 duration for the processing deadline (e.g. P30D)

isDraft.description: Whether this case type is a draft (not yet published)

validFrom.description: Date from which this case type is valid

validUntil.description: Date until which this case type is valid (null = indefinite)

suspensionAllowed.description: Whether cases of this type can be suspended

extensionAllowed.description: Whether the processing deadline can be extended

extensionPeriod.description: ISO 8601 duration for extension period (e.g. P14D)

publicationRequired.description: Whether publication of the decision is required

internalOrExternal.description: Whether the case type is internal or external

productsOrServices.description: URLs to products or services (JSON-encoded array)

selectionListProcessType.description: URL to the selection list process type

decisionTypes.description: References to decision types (besluittypen) linked to this case type

statusType.title: Status Type
statusType.description: Status lifecycle phase definition for a case type

name.description: Name of this status (e.g. Ontvangen, In behandeling)

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

order.description: Position in the status lifecycle (lower = earlier)

isFinal.description: Whether this is a terminal/final status

resultType.title: Result Type
resultType.description: Case outcome type with archival rules

name.description: Name of this result type (e.g. Vergunning verleend)

genericDescription.description: Generic description derived from selectielijst resultaattypeomschrijving

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

archivalAction.description: What to do after archival period: keep or destroy

sourceDateArchiveProcedure.description: BrondatumArchiefprocedure configuration (JSON-encoded object with afleidingswijze, procestermijn, datumkenmerk, etc.)

roleType.title: Role Type
roleType.description: Participant role type definition for a case type

name.description: Name of this role type (e.g. Behandelaar, Adviseur)

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

propertyDefinition.title: Property Definition
propertyDefinition.description: Custom field definition for a case type

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

isRequired.description: Whether this property is required on cases

documentType.title: Document Type
documentType.description: Document type requirement for a case type

name.description: Name of this document type (e.g. Situatietekening)

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

isDraft.description: Whether this document type is a draft (concept)

isRequired.description: Whether this document is required for the case

validFrom.description: Date from which this document type is valid

validUntil.description: Date until which this document type is valid

decisionType.title: Decision Type
decisionType.description: Decision type definition for a case type

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

isDraft.description: Whether this decision type is a draft (concept)

publicationRequired.description: Whether this decision type requires publication

caseTypes.description: References to case types (array of zaaktype URLs)

documentTypes.description: References to document types (array of informatieobjecttype URLs)

validFrom.description: Date from which this decision type is valid

validUntil.description: Date until which this decision type is valid

case.title: Case
case.description: A case instance in the case management system

status.description: Reference to the current status type
status.title: Status

result.description: Reference to the result record (set on completion)

assignee.description: Nextcloud user ID of the primary handler
assignee.title: Assignee

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry for location-based cases (JSON-encoded object)

sourceOrganisation.description: RSIN of the organization that created this case

archiveNomination.description: Whether the case should be permanently archived or destroyed

archiveActionDate.description: Date when the archive action should be executed

archiveStatus.description: Current archive status of the case

communicationChannel.description: URL reference to the communication channel

workflowTemplate.description: Reference to the bound workflow template

workflowVersion.description: Version number of the bound workflow template

assignee.description: Nextcloud user ID of the assigned user
assignee.title: Assignee

workflowStepId.description: UUID of the workflow step that generated this task

checklist.description: JSON-encoded array of checklist items ({id, label, checked})

role.title: Role
role.description: A role assignment on a case

name.description: Display name for this role assignment

participant.description: Nextcloud user ID or contact reference

statusRecord.title: Status Record
statusRecord.description: A status transition record for a case

decision.title: Decision
decision.description: A formal decision on a case

governingBody.description: The governing body that made the decision (bestuursorgaan)

document.title: Document
document.description: A document (enkelvoudig informatieobject) in the document registry

format.description: MIME type of the document (e.g. application/pdf)

content.description: Base64-encoded file content or file reference

locked.description: Whether the document is locked for editing

fileParts.description: References to file parts for chunked uploads (JSON-encoded array)

usageRightsIndication.description: Indicates whether usage rights have been set for this document

documentLink.title: Document Link
documentLink.description: A link between a document and a case or decision

object.description: URI reference to the related object (zaak or besluit)

kanaal.title: Notification Channel
kanaal.description: A notification channel (kanaal) for ZGW event distribution

naam.description: Name of this channel (e.g. zaken, documenten)

documentatieLink.description: URL to API documentation for this channel

filters.description: Available filter attributes for this channel (JSON-encoded array)

abonnement.title: Notification Subscription
abonnement.description: A subscription (abonnement) for receiving ZGW notifications

auth.description: Authorization header value for callback requests

kanalen.description: Channels and filters to subscribe to (JSON-encoded array)

catalogus.title: Catalogus
catalogus.description: A catalogus groups case types, decision types, and document types

contactpersoonBeheerTelefoonnummer.description: Phone number of the management contact

zaaktypeInformatieobjecttype.title: Zaaktype-Informatieobjecttype Relation
zaaktypeInformatieobjecttype.description: Links a case type to a document type with direction and ordering

richting.description: Direction of the document in the case

caseProperty.title: Case Property
caseProperty.description: A property value on a specific case

caseDocument.title: Case Document Link
caseDocument.description: Links a document to a case

caseObject.title: Case Object
caseObject.description: Links an external object to a case

customerContact.title: Customer Contact
customerContact.description: A customer contact moment for a case

decisionDocument.title: Decision Document Link
decisionDocument.description: Links a document to a decision

startDate.description: Start date of the usage rights

endDate.description: End date of the usage rights

voorstel.title: Voorstel
voorstel.description: A B&W voorstel (proposal) for decision-making in a case

onderwerp.description: Subject of the voorstel (usually derived from case title)

steller.description: Nextcloud user UID who created the voorstel
steller.title: Steller

portefeuillehouder.description: Nextcloud user UID of the responsible portfolio holder (wethouder)

status.description: Current status of the voorstel in the parafering lifecycle
status.title: Status

parafeerroute.description: Reference to the parafeerroute being used

routeSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the parafeerroute steps at submission time (JSON-encoded array)

currentStep.description: Current step number in the parafeerroute (1-based, 0 = not yet submitted)

returnedFromStep.description: Step number from which the voorstel was returned (for resume on resubmit)

document.description: Nextcloud file ID of the primary voorstel document

bijlagen.description: Nextcloud file IDs of attached documents (bijlagen)

behandeling.description: Treatment type in the college meeting

decision.description: Reference to the linked decision (set when besluit is registered)

parafeerroute.title: Parafeerroute
parafeerroute.description: A configurable endorsement route defining the sequence of parafering steps for a voorstel

name.description: Name of this parafeerroute (e.g. Collegeadvies - Omgevingsvergunning)

caseType.description: Reference to the case type this route is associated with

voorstelType.description: Voorstel type this route applies to

actor.description: User UID, group name, or role name

mandatory.description: Whether this step can be skipped

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default route for the linked case type and voorstel type

description.description: Description of when this route should be used

parafeeractie.title: Parafeeractie
parafeeractie.description: An immutable record of a parafering action on a voorstel step

actor.description: Nextcloud user UID who performed the action

actorType.description: Whether the actor acted directly or as delegate

onBehalfOf.description: Nextcloud user UID of the principal (if acting as delegate)

workflowTemplate.title: Workflow Template
workflowTemplate.description: A workflow definition for a case type — defines process steps, status transitions, guards, and automatic actions

description.description: Purpose and usage notes for this workflow

caseType.description: Reference to the case type this workflow belongs to

isActive.description: Whether this is the active version for new cases

isDraft.description: Draft templates cannot be used for new cases

steps.description: JSON-encoded array of WorkflowStep objects. Each step has: id (UUID), title, description, status (UUID ref to statusType), order (integer), assigneeRole (UUID ref to roleType, optional), isRequired (boolean), checklist (array of {id, label, description}), automaticActions (array of ActionRef)

transitions.description: JSON-encoded array of StatusTransition objects. Each transition has: id (UUID), fromStatus (UUID), toStatus (UUID), label (string), guards (array of Guard), automaticActions (array of ActionRef), allowedRoles (array of UUID). Guard types: checklist, requiredField, requiredDocument, roleGuard. Action types: sendEmail, createTask, createSubCase, webhook, setField, notify

nodePositions.description: JSON-encoded map of status UUID to {x, y} canvas positions for the visual editor

parentWorkflow.description: Reference to parent workflow template for inheritance (Enterprise tier)

objection.title: Objection
objection.description: Bezwaarschrift (objection letter) — captures the formal objection content linked to a bezwaar case and the contested decision

case.description: The bezwaar case this objection belongs to

grounds.description: The grounds for objection (gronden van bezwaar)

isTimely.description: Whether the objection was filed within the 6-week term (Awb art. 6:7)

proVoorziening.description: Whether a voorlopige voorziening (interim relief) was requested

attachments.description: JSON-encoded array of document references uploaded by bezwaarmaker

hearingSession.title: Hearing Session
hearingSession.description: Hoorzitting (hearing) — manages scheduling, invitations, and minutes for bezwaar hearings per Awb art. 7:2

case.description: The bezwaar case this hearing belongs to

scheduledDate.description: Date and time of the hearing

location.description: Physical location or 'Online' for video hearings

videoCallUrl.description: Video conference link for online hearings

members.description: JSON-encoded array of committee member role UUIDs

invitees.description: JSON-encoded array of invitee objects (name, role, email, status)

minutesDocument.description: Reference to full hearing minutes document

hearingWaived.description: Bezwaarmaker has waived the right to be heard

advisoryReport.title: Advisory Report
advisoryReport.description: Advisory committee report (advies bezwaarschriftencommissie) — records the committee's advice on a bezwaar case per Awb art. 7:13

case.description: The bezwaar case this report belongs to

hearingSession.description: The hearing session this report is based on

committeeMembers.description: JSON-encoded array of committee member role UUIDs

adviceType.description: Type of advice: upheld, rejected, partially upheld, inadmissible

grounds.description: Legal reasoning and grounds for the advice

deviationFromPrimaryDecision.description: Whether the committee advises differently from the original decision

reportDocument.description: Reference to full advisory report document

appealDecision.title: Appeal Decision
appealDecision.description: Beslissing op bezwaar (decision on objection) — formal decision recording with disposition, motivation, and rechtsmiddelenclausule per Awb art. 7:11-7:12

dispositionDetails.description: Detailed motivation for the decision (motiveringsplicht art. 7:12)

followsAdvice.description: Whether the decision follows the committee's advice

deviationReason.description: Reason for deviating from committee advice (required when followsAdvice is false)

replacementDecision.description: New besluit that replaces the contested one

effectiveDate.description: Date the decision takes legal effect

decisionMaker.description: The person/body that made the decision

decisionDocument.description: Reference to the formal decision letter document

mapLayer.title: Map Layer
mapLayer.description: GIS map layer configuration for case maps — defines tile, WMS, WFS, or GeoJSON layers that can be displayed on case map views

title.description: Display name for the layer in the layer switcher

layerType.description: The type of map layer (tile, wms, wfs, or geojson)

url.description: Service URL (tile template, WMS base URL, WFS endpoint, or GeoJSON URL)

isDefault.description: Whether to show this layer on initial load

isBaseLayer.description: If true, only one base layer visible at a time

order.description: Display order in the layer switcher

style.description: JSON-encoded style object for GeoJSON/WFS features (color, weight, fillColor, fillOpacity)

proxyEnabled.description: Whether to route requests through the backend GIS proxy (for CORS-restricted services)

adviesAanvraag.title: Advice Request
adviesAanvraag.description: A request for internal or external advice on a case, with deadline tracking

case.description: Reference to the case this advice is requested for

type.description: Whether advice is from internal staff or external party

status.description: Current status of the advice request

adviesDocument.description: Nextcloud file ID of the advice document

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the advice was requested

receivedAt.description: Timestamp when the advice was received

handhavingsactie.title: Enforcement Action
handhavingsactie.description: An enforcement action (handhavingsactie) on a case, classified per the Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie (LHS)

ernst.description: Severity of the violation (LHS ernst axis)

gedrag.description: Behavior of the violator (LHS gedrag axis)

interventie.description: Suggested intervention from LHS matrix (may be overridden)

begunstigingstermijn.description: Grace period in days before enforcement takes effect

effectueringsDatum.description: Date when enforcement action takes effect

status.description: Current status of the enforcement action

overrideReason.description: Documented reasoning if the LHS suggestion was overridden

inspectieChecklist.title: Inspection Checklist
inspectieChecklist.description: Configurable inspection checklist template linked to a case type, with versioning support

name.description: Name of this checklist (e.g. 'Bouwtoezicht fase 1 - Fundering')

caseType.description: Reference to the case type this checklist belongs to

version.description: Version number of this checklist (incremented on edit)

status.description: Lifecycle status of this checklist version

required.description: Whether this item must be completed

fotoRequired.description: Whether a photo is required (especially on failure)

inspectieRapport.title: Inspection Report
inspectieRapport.description: A completed inspection report generated from a checklist, stored on the case

case.description: Reference to the case (toezichtzaak) this report belongs to

inspectionDate.description: Date and time of the inspection

location.description: GPS coordinates or address of the inspection location

itemId.description: Reference to the original checklist item

photos.description: Nextcloud file IDs of photos for this item
All Nextcloud file IDs of photos taken during inspection

procest.title: Procest
procest.description: Case management (zaakgericht werken) register for Procest — manages case types, status types, cases, tasks, roles, results, and decisions.
